race.comment: BRONCO REVOLUTION (4) turned in a much better effort last time out to score by a head over 1000m at Wangaratta. Has trialled well since and now she's got her confidence back she might be able to go on with it. EL SALTO (2) drifted well back last start before winding up strongly to finish second, beaten one length, over 1000m at Donald. That was the best effort in a while, a repeat of which would have him in the mix here. AMERICAN RUSS (3) resumes. Wasn't far away at last run before a break, finishing fourth over 1100m at Bendigo three-and-a-half months ago. One of the genuine hopes. LA CACHE A VIN (1) is another resuming, in what will be the first start for the Noble camp, and a recent Kerang trial win suggests he's come to hand well. SOOBOOMA (6) hasn't been able to break through for an extended period, the latest effort an eighth over 1247m at Geelong. Finds a more suitable race and can improve.
